units.source_text: 本回紧接前回，从源氏四十一岁三月开始记事，

en.t: This chapter follows directly after the previous one, beginning its account in the third month of Genji's forty-first year,

units.source_text: 但从四十二岁至四十五岁这四年间没有记载，

en.t: but there is no record for the four years from his forty-second through forty-fifth years,

units.source_text: 以后又记载了从四十六岁至四十七岁十二月之事。

en.t: and afterward it records events from his forty-sixth year through the twelfth month of his forty-seventh year.
